Subject: Kickoff: MAP & integration sprint (Lighthouse GovCom)

Hi Soojin / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Lighthouse is keen to move from evaluation to a short pilot focused on internal document redaction and policy-aware generation. Procurement asked that we put a simple mutual action plan together with milestone dates and named owners so they can align budgeting and review timelines.

Can you share a draft MAP and a proposed sprint cadence (milestones, owners, target dates, and any gating dependencies)? Procurement will need a licensing overview for the PO.

People to know on our side: Tom Alvarez (IT lead) — tom.alvarez@lighthouse.gov; Procurement inbox — procurement@lighthouse.gov.

Goal: pilot into sandbox by mid-September, production by end of November if the pilot is successful.

Thanks — Heather
Heather Lin

Lighthouse GovCom

Heather — great to kick this off. Attached is a first-pass MAP in spreadsheet form (Lighthouse_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) plus the high-level sprint outline below. I kept dates conservative based on our current capacity and the procurement window you mentioned.

High-level mutual action plan (draft):
- Milestone A: PO & licensing signed
  - Owner: Procurement (Lighthouse) / Ben Carter (Redwood sales)
  - Target: 2025-09-01
  - Dependencies: Legal review, SOW acceptance

- Milestone B: Sandbox provisioned + baseline integration (SFTP + API auth)
  - Owner: Tom Alvarez (Lighthouse IT) / Jordan Blake (Redwood eng support)
  - Target: 2025-09-12
  - Dependencies: Network allowlist, KMS key exchange

- Milestone C: Pilot (30-day) — redaction & policy tests
  - Owner: Lighthouse product lead / Marissa Cole (Redwood CS)

- Milestone C (continued): Pilot (30-day) — redaction & policy tests
  - Owner: Lighthouse product lead / Marissa Cole (Redwood CS)
  - Target: 2025-10-12
  - Dependencies: Sandbox data subset, evaluation prompts, security questionnaire completion

- Milestone D: Acceptance testing & training (UAT + runbook)
  - Owner: Marissa Cole (CS) / Lighthouse stakeholders
  - Target: 2025-11-02
  - Dependencies: Completed pilot, documented acceptance criteria

- Milestone E: Production cutover (regional deployment)
  - Owner: Jordan Blake (Redwood) / Tom Alvarez (Lighthouse)
  - Target: 2025-11-30
  - Dependencies: SLA sign-off, capacity reservation

Notes / asks:
- Ben: please confirm pricing & PO cadence (I attached a short licensing SOW draft LICENSING_SOW-draft.pdf).
- Tom: can you confirm the expected timeline for allowlist/IP windows and KMS key provisioning?
- Marissa: I'll need a short implementation runbook (pre-prod checklist, training slots, acceptance criteria).

If this looks good I'll convert the sheet to a living MAP and create a weekly 30-minute cadence for the next 8 weeks.

Thanks — Soojin

Subject: Implementation runbook & acceptance criteria (Lighthouse pilot)

Hi all — jumping in from CS. Attached is a compressed runbook and acceptance checklist (implementation-runbook.pdf) with suggested training slots and who should own each test case. Key excerpts below.

Pre-pilot (owners):
- Data subset & DLP review — Lighthouse product lead / Marissa Cole (CS) — target 2025-08-29
- Test prompt set & success criteria (precision/recall) — Lighthouse SMEs / Marissa Cole — target 2025-09-04
- Access matrix & roles configured — Tom Alvarez / Jordan Blake — target 2025-09-08

Pilot execution (30 days):
- Week 0: Smoke + baseline throughput tests (Jordan)
- Week 1–2: Redaction scenario testing (Marissa + Lighthouse SMEs)
- Week 3: Policy enforcement & fallback checks (security checkpoint)
- Week 4: Acceptance sweep — pass metrics and signoff

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- Redaction accuracy >= 98% on labeled set
- Policy violations detected and blocked in 100% of seeded probes
- Average token latency < 120ms for the configured model profile during pilot

I recommend a 30-minute security checkpoint call after Week 2.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
